body:
﻿DEV-237 updates Sync-SeatMap `-Verify` operator contract and verifies seat-map heads against workspace terminals.

What this PR does
- Read-only `Sync-SeatMap.ps1 -Verify` head-rung workspace check: parses `workspace.json`, matches each seat `roleId` to the corresponding terminal `assignedRoleId`, and fails/accumulates findings with exit code 1 on any workspace/seat issue.
- Output is read-only + redacted: no full launch strings are emitted; only hashed/identifier evidence is printed (redaction contract matches `CLAUDE.md` + ADR prose).
- `-All` keeps existing write/sync behavior, then runs verify last; on verify failure the receipt “Sync phases completed before verify failure; workspace drift remains.” is emitted with no rollback.

Documentation blocker fixes (2)
- `AGENTS.md`: added the Codex-side reachability pointer naming `Sync-SeatMap.ps1 -Verify` and pointing Codex operators to the root operator contract in `CLAUDE.md`.
- `CLAUDE.md` + `docs/adr/0025-versioned-seat-map-and-canvas-portal.md`: qualified the fatal/error prose to distinguish workspace-level fatals (stop before seat comparison) vs seat-level findings collection.

Local evidence (native gates)
- `git diff --check` passes.
- `Test-SeatMapLive.ps1` passes (225 checks, 0 failures; no exit 2).
- Additional local harness gates pass: `Test-InstallArtifacts.ps1`, `Test-ContextFloor.ps1`, `Report-ContextFloor.ps1 -Baseline`, `Test-BaselineGuard.ps1`.

Proof scope note
- Real `~/.maestri` operator proof is machine-local; this PR’s CI/fixture proof is exercised via `Test-SeatMapLive.ps1` (isolated HOME + fixture data), matching the operator-documentation split.

This PR is opened for review and CI gate verification; it is not claiming ready-to-merge.
title: DEV-237 - Sync-SeatMap -Verify: head-rung verification + doc contract fixes
